step1_analysis.description: A Current Mode Logic (CML) D-latch with dual differential outputs (I and Q). It tracks the input data when the clock is high and holds the state using a cross-coupled quad when the clock is low, commonly used in high-speed dividers or phase shifters.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Power 200-MHz Receiver for Wireless Hearing Aid Devices

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the latch from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 1.8V supply and two 5uA tail currents, total current is 10uA. Power = 1.8V * 10uA = 18uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for a single block in 1.8V technology compared to the full receiver.

output_voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the single-ended outputs.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the fixed resistor values in the netlist and the chosen tail current to keep transistors in the forward-active region.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from the 50% point of the data input edge to the 50% point of the output edge when the clock is transparent.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC time constant at the output nodes. R=35k, C_parasitic ~ 10fF. tau = 350ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 35k resistors create a relatively large time constant, limiting the maximum speed but saving power.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, output swing, and propagation delay of the CML D-Latch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML D-Latch Testbench
.model npn npn (bf=100 is=1e-16 vaf=50)

* DUT
Q1 N_Q1_C LO_P N_M1_D npn
Q2 N_Q2_C LO_N N_M1_D npn
Q9 N_Q9_C LO_N N_M2_D npn
Q3 N_Q3_C LO_P N_M2_D npn
Q11 I_P D_P N_Q1_C npn
Q6 I_N D_N N_Q1_C npn
Q7 I_P Q_P N_Q2_C npn
Q4 I_N Q_N N_Q2_C npn
Q12 Q_P I_P N_Q9_C npn
Q5 Q_N I_N N_Q9_C npn
Q8 Q_P D_P N_Q3_C npn
Q10 Q_N D_N N_Q3_C npn
R3 I_P N_TOP 35k
R4 I_N N_TOP 35k
R1 Q_P N_TOP 35k
R2 Q_N N_TOP 35k
R5 N_TOP VDD 24.6k

* Tail currents
I1 N_M1_D 0 5u
I2 N_M2_D 0 5u

* Supplies and Inputs
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Clock (LO) at 200MHz, biased at 0.76V
VLO_P LO_P 0 dc 0.76 pulse(0.66 0.86 0 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)
VLO_N LO_N 0 dc 0.76 pulse(0.86 0.66 0 100p 100p 2.4n 5n)
* Data (D) at 66.6MHz, biased at 1.46V, shifted by 1ns to transition during transparent phase
VD_P D_P 0 dc 1.46 pulse(1.36 1.56 1n 100p 100p 7.4n 15n)
VD_N D_N 0 dc 1.46 pulse(1.56 1.36 1n 100p 100p 7.4n 15n)

.control
tran 10p 30n

* Power Measurement
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

* Voltage Swing Measurement
meas tran v_I_P_max max v(I_P)
meas tran v_I_P_min min v(I_P)
let swing = v_I_P_max - v_I_P_min
print swing

* Propagation Delay Measurement (Data to Output)
meas tran t_delay trig v(D_P) val=1.46 rise=1 targ v(I_P) val=1.46 fall=1

* Rise and Fall Time Measurement (10% to 90% of 1.38V-1.55V swing)
meas tran t_rise trig v(I_P) val=1.40 rise=1 targ v(I_P) val=1.53 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(I_P) val=1.53 fall=1 targ v(I_P) val=1.40 fall=1

quit
.endc
